revised_hypotheses: Salermide's strong H3K79me0/me1 anchor signal may reflect reduced H3K79 methylation, making DOT1L inhibition by EPZ-5676 a mechanistic donor.
DNMT inhibitors zebularine and decitabine share high anchor similarity with salermide, suggesting overlapping epigenetic histone mark changes despite different primary targets.
UNC1215 and methylstat lack retrieved pharmacology descriptions, so their donor support remains unverified.
unresolved: No retrieved source describes salermide's own histone or sirtuin pharmacology.
